suggested strategies.Geographic Optimization: Transfer appropriate patients from Long Island service areas to lower-cost regions when feasible. Partner with hospitals in non-Suffolk counties for cost-sharing opportunities.
suggested strategies.Clinical Pathway Improvements: Expand outpatient alcohol treatment programs to reduce inpatient admissions. Prioritize admissions to cost-effective St. Charles Hospital when clinically appropriate. Optimize care protocols to maintain 4-day length of stay where safe. Utilize outpatient detox programs for eligible substance use cases.
suggested strategies.Payment Optimization: Maintain Medicaid enrollment for eligible patients.
suggested strategies.Treatment Selection: Prefer medical management over surgical interventions when equally effective.
suggested strategies.Preventive Care: Enhance early intervention for moderate severity cases to prevent escalation. Strengthen monitoring for minor risk mortality cases.
